text: Moore Street Senior Apartments. This consisted of an air leakage test, building survey/walkthrough, and the creation of an Energy Star Portfolio Manager (ESPM) profile for the building. NLR staff have provided the results of the building survey in this report along with a list of window replacement considerations and best practices, building ventilation considerations and best practices, and further considerations to reduce the annual energy costs and improve indoor air quality in the apartment building. vi This report is available at no cost from the National Laboratory of the Rockies (NLR) at www.nlr.gov/publications.
